name: Smishing basics
description: Fake texts that try to get you to click, reply, or share fast.

name: Password safety basics
description: Use long, unique passwords and store them somewhere safe.

name: Fake links and downloads
description: If a message pushes you to act fast, pause and check the website yourself.

name: Public Wi‑Fi caution
description: Shared networks can be risky. Avoid banking or passwords on open Wi‑Fi.

name: What to do after a breach
description: Change passwords, check accounts, and watch for strange messages or charges.

name: App permissions basics
description: Only allow access that makes sense for the app you are using.

name: Device lock and recovery
description: Use a strong screen lock and set a backup recovery method.

name: Scam calls and robocalls
description: Scammers may pressure you to act quickly. Hang up and call back using a trusted number.

name: Social engineering signs
description: People may pretend to be trusted helpers, friends, or companies.

name: Safe downloads and updates
description: Only install apps and updates from official stores or trusted sources.
